name: agentic-review
description: Risk-tiered, evidence-first review for local code changes and software design documents.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first review for code and designs
interface.longDescription: Triage local code changes and software design documents by blast radius, run appropriate verification, surface high-confidence findings, and reserve consequential decisions for a human owner.
defaultPrompt: Review my local code changes by risk and evidence.
Review this design document and identify decision gaps.
